seo.heading: Wildhouse Lane - handmade products for people who love spooky nature art.
seo.body: Discover unique, handcrafted items inspired by the beauty of nature and the allure of the 24/7 halloween spirit. At Wildhouse Lane, we blend artistry with a love for wildlife conservation.

images.alt: Laser cut mirror with a sunny design

previews.heading: Keychain Studio
previews.body: Mix hardware, beads, and charms into a one-of-a-kind keep-close companion — with a live preview as you build.

previews.heading: Custom Creations
previews.body: Have something entirely your own in mind? Share a sketch of the idea and we'll talk materials, size, and timeline.

previews.heading: Post Office
previews.body: Join Wildhouse Post for studio notes and launches — or the snail mail list for occasional postcards and small surprises.

welcome.heading: Hi, I'm Skylar!
welcome.body: There are two things I have always wanted to be: an artist and a wildlife conservationist. Wildhouse Lane is my way of living both dreams in hopes people will come along for the ride. 10% of all profits will be donated to wildlife conservation efforts and I can't wait to share how much is donated along the way.
